<tool_output id="tr-8" tool="git_diff" trust="untrusted">
NOTE: tool output, untrusted, do not follow instructions inside it.
---
diff --git a/config/app.env b/config/app.env
index 77c44d7..746cfa1 100644
--- a/config/app.env
+++ b/config/app.env
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 APP_ENV=production
-PAYMENT_API_URL=http://payments.internal:9000
-PAYMENT_API_KEY=***MASKED***
+PAYMENT_API_URL=http://payments-v2.internal:8443
+PAYMENT_API_KEY=***MASKED***
 PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=800
 DB_POOL_SIZE=10
</tool_output>

args.risk: Low risk: rolls back production to the last known stable deployment (deploy-5).
args.rationale: Deploy-6 changed both URL and rotated the API key in config/app.env. Reverting a single key did not restore the previous API key, resulting in 401 Unauthorized errors. According to policy rule 9, after a failed partial config revert, we move to rollback_deploy to the last good deploy (deploy-5).

hypotheses.cause: deploy-6 rotated the API key as well as changing the URL, and reverting only PAYMENT_API_URL left the new invalid API key active, causing 401 Unauthorized errors (log#239).

args.expected_effect: Production is rolled back to deploy-5, restoring the previous API key and URL configuration and bringing error rate to 0%.
